content: A husband sought the division of a home built on land donated to both spouses. During the proceedings, the parties signed a private settlement agreement (transazione) resolving all property disputes. The Court applied the principle that a valid extrajudicial agreement eliminates the "interest to act," leading to a declaration of "cessazione della materia del contendere". This ruling confirms that private autonomy is a valid and preferred method for dissolving common ownership, terminating the need for a judicial decree on the merits.
